normalized_facts: Google's final incident report states that an update to payment configuration intended to support virtual credit cards triggered the disruption.
The configuration update prevented credit-card payments from being processed for affected United States customers and generated payment-failure notifications.
Engineers observed an unexpected increase in payment-request failures, rolled back the configuration change, and the rollback resolved the payment-processing failure condition.
The incident report identifies progressive rollout errors as a factor that expanded the configuration change more rapidly than intended.
